home.lookbookTitle: From the shoot in the Judean desert
home.crew1: We are Shevatim: a group of friends making hooded, poncho-cut tzitziyot and desert streetwear.
home.crew2: We shot our first collection, Midbar, in the Judean desert, among the chalk cliffs, with a camel, a shofar and a turquoise motorbike.
home.crew3: Every piece in the collection belongs to one of the twelve tribes.
home.how1: Go through the collection and add what you like to your reservation.
home.how2: A name and a phone number, that is all. You pay nothing now and enter no card.
home.how3: We get in touch within one business day to confirm size, price and delivery.

about.title: About
about.p1: Shevatim is a group of friends making hooded, poncho-cut tzitziyot and desert streetwear: cream and striped woven cloth, fringe and tassels, a band of gold sequins, and tzitzit strings with a thread of tekhelet blue.
about.p2: Our first collection is called Midbar, the Hebrew word for desert. We shot it in the Judean desert, among the white chalk cliffs, with a camel, a shofar and a turquoise motorbike. The people in the pictures are us and our friends.
about.p3: For each of the twelve tribes we chose five pieces. You reserve on the site, and we’ll contact you to settle size, price and delivery.

terms.title: Reservation terms
terms.draft: Temporary wording. This is a template, not legal text. The final, binding terms are the shop’s and will be published on this page.
terms.t1: A reservation is not a purchase. It is a request to hold a piece for you.
terms.t2: Nothing is charged on the site and no card details are asked for.
terms.t3: After you send a reservation, the shop will contact you to confirm size, price and delivery.
terms.t4: For a piece that has no price yet, the price is confirmed when we contact you.
terms.t5: We receive the details you leave in the form in order to contact you about your reservation.
terms.t6: Everything else, including cancellation, returns and delivery, will be set out in the shop’s final terms.

footer.line: A reservation is not a purchase and nothing is charged on the site. After you reserve, we’ll contact you to confirm size, price and delivery.
